dben par gnas pa'i dge slong gcig pu'i gso sbyong bzhugs/༈swasti/dge slong gcig pu dben par gnas pa dag gis zla ba phyed phyed kyi gso sbyong byi

tei:div.tei:p: dben par gnas pa'i dge slong gcig pu'i gso sbyong bzhugs/ ༈ swasti/ dge slong gcig pu dben par gnas pa dag gis zla ba phyed phyed kyi gso sbyong byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ dang po thub dbang gi sku dang maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod pa gang 'byor bshams la/ sangs rgyas chos sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad sogs lan gsum/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag sogs/ ma lus sems can sogs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ srab 'jam yangs pa sogs/ de las gzhan yang sogs/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba'am thal mo sbyar la/ ji snyed su dag sogs/ bsdu na/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs brjod/ yig brgya dang maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma rgyas pa'am 'bring po/ bsdu na/ sa gzhi spos sogs/ rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang thal mo sbyar bzhin/ thub bstod gang rung zhig dang/ thams cad mkhyen pa sogs dkon mchog rjes dran mdo bton/ skar ma rab rib sogs/ chos rnams thams cad sogs/ bstan pa yin bar dang*/ lus kyi sdom pa sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ phyag gsum 'tshal nas thang shad bcas tsog pur thal mo sbyar la/ lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag smra na/ bdag yongs su dag par lha rnams kyis gzung du gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bya bas tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlab bo// gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig du gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing*/ so so thar pa'i mdo gdon par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ lha rnams kyis/ thabs yin no// gsung bar mos la/

lan du/ legs so brjod la phyag gsum dang thang shad bcas 'khod nas/ khrims kyi tshul khrims sogs/ rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te// bzang po spyod pa yongs su sogs nas/ spyod par shog bar/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i sogs/ rgyal ba byams pa sogs/ dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs sogs/ ji ltar sngon gyi sogs brjod/ de ltar byas pas ltung ba mi 'phel bar byin gyis brlab par 'gyur zhes/ rje chos kyi dbang phyung gi gsung rgyun las byung zhing*/ rang re bstan sgor 'jug pa rnams kyi don ched du 7 si tu pad+ma'i ming gis zin thor spel zhing*/ 'di hor zla gnyis pa/ bzhi pa/ drug pa/ brgyad pa/ bcu pa/ bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nyer dgu chad pa'i gnam stong la gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa dang*/ de 'phro'i gnam stong rnams dang*/ bco lnga kun la gso sbyong bco lnga pa ste/ zla bshol skabs zla ba de'i sngon rjes gnyis kar dus tshigs 'dra bar brjod dgos so// maṅga lam/// /
